rows.note: Use 豪宅 as the all-purpose spoken term for a large, luxurious home.

example.english: They moved into that mansion halfway up the hill.
example.traditional: 佢哋一家人搬咗入半山嗰間豪宅。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 jan4 bun1 zo2 jap6 bun3 saan1 go2 gaan1 hou4 zaak2

rows.note: Use 大宅 when emphasizing the property’s size or presenting it as a grand residence.

example.english: That mansion has three storeys and a big garden.
example.traditional: 嗰座大宅有成三層樓，仲有個大花園。
example.jyutping: go2 zo6 daai6 zaak6 jau5 sing4 saam1 cang4 lau4 zung6 jau5 go3 daai6 faa1 jyun4

rows.note: Use 大屋 for a large house in casual speech when the luxury aspect is less important.

example.english: The mansion at the village entrance is quite suitable for the whole family to live in.
example.traditional: 村口嗰間大屋幾啱一家大細住。
example.jyutping: cyun1 hau2 go2 gaan1 daai6 uk1 gei2 ngaam1 jat1 gaa1 daai6 sai3 zyu6
